scope: Exact finite examples and algebra; no numerical proof of RH, generic geometry, physical validation or current-data claim.

checks.name: Exhaustive diagram matchings
checks.detail: All 7 partial bijections enumerated with all unmatched points sent to diagonal.

checks.name: Graph Dirac polynomial and nullity
checks.detail: Exact D(D²−I)(D²−3I)=0 and rank 4, agreeing with spectrum 0,±1,±√3; no assertion about zeta zeros.

checks.name: Exact historical stipulated covariance calculation
checks.detail: Exact mean .173, variance .02898125, positive leading principal minors; inputs are stipulated historical values.

checks.name: Energy-density dimensions and isotropic transport factor
checks.detail: n hc/λ has energy-density dimensions; multiplying by speed supplies flux. Hemisphere integral (2π)(1/2)/(4π)=1/4 under isotropic convention.

checks.name: Deformation tangent and obstruction
checks.detail: For u=1+aε, relation u²=1 gives 2a=0. At char 2 the lift 1+η+bη² has unavoidable η² coefficient 1; all b share the obstruction.

checks.name: Prime-level subgroup index finite enumeration
checks.detail: SL₂(F_p) and upper triangular determinant-one subgroup enumerated completely for p=2,3,5, giving index p+1.

checks.name: Lorentz condition and semidirect commutator
checks.detail: Exact rational boost preserves signature (−+++); [boost, translation e₀] translates by (2/3,4/3,0,0).

checks.name: Symmetry does not imply critical-line zeros
checks.detail: Exact coefficients satisfy P(1−s)=P(s); factors visibly have roots 1/4±i and 3/4±i. This changes analytic class and is not a counterexample to RH.

checks.name: Projective-line zeta coefficient identity
checks.detail: Log-derivative recurrence from point counts matches rational zeta 1/((1−t)(1−2t)) through degree 8; counts differ from series coefficients.

checks.name: Associative first-order deformation
checks.detail: All 64 basis triples in k[x]/(x⁴) checked; identify ε=x², so x²=ε and ε²=0, a free rank-two dual-number algebra.

checks.name: Gauss norm multiplicativity example
checks.detail: p=3 polynomial example has all Gauss norms 1; T−a has norm 1 despite evaluating to zero at a. General multiplicativity is proved by reduction in text.

checks.name: BV differential and odd Jacobi identities
checks.detail: Δ²=0 on six basis monomials; all 216 homogeneous monomial Jacobi triples replayed with shifted signs; two displayed brackets exact. General second-order identity proved in text.

checks.name: Atomic local Hardy–BMO pairing
checks.detail: For I=[−1,1], a=sign(x)/2 has mean zero, sup norm 1/2, pairing ∫|x|/2=1/2, and mean oscillation |I|⁻¹∫|x|=1/2. Full duality is sourced, not proved by this one atom.

checks.name: Power-law ratios and finite-data nonuniqueness
checks.detail: Exact scale ratios and elimination exponent 4 verified; perturbation vanishes at n=2,4 and not n=3, so finitely many samples do not identify a global power law.
